scenes.standard.title: Standard view
scenes.standard.components.narrative.tex:
Morning light falls through the museum’s high windows. Beyond the entrance hall, voices drift between the marble pillars.

A curator waits beside a display of old maps. She looks up from her notes as you approach.

“Look for the blue seal,” she says, nodding toward the table. “It bears the same crest as the display case in the east gallery.”

A door between the pillars leads east.

museum.rules.clue: “At the east display case, press the heron beneath the crown. The keyhole is a decoy.”
museum.rules.read: Read the letter and found a clue to the display case.
museum.rules.caseLocked: At the far end, the display case bears a brass crest with two raised symbols, a crown and a heron. The folded letter might explain how the case opens.
museum.rules.wrongSymbol: The crown clicks under your finger. The case stays locked.
museum.rules.caseOpen: The heron sinks into the crest and the lid springs open. Inside is a chart of the old harbour with a safe passage marked through the shoals.
museum.rules.opened: Opened the display case and uncovered an old harbour chart.
museum.rules.caseEmpty: The display case stands open. A pale rectangle on the velvet marks where the chart lay.
museum.rules.chartPickup: Took the harbour chart from the display case.
museum.rules.chartDetails: A red line threads the shoals from the old harbour to a landing below the north cliffs.
museum.rules.chartRead: Traced the safe route marked on the harbour chart.
